lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible. Posterior to the gills, these spots align into distinct vertical columns, creating a geometric grid across the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of circular blobs, functioning as anchor nodes for the grid-like pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a highlight on the upper edge and shadow on the lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, vertical linear marking is present on the flank, superior to the pectoral fin insertion point.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, irregular clustering of smaller high-luminance spots on the dorsal surface of the head anterior to the gill slits.
